name: UFS_UPIU (Protocol Diagram)
description: JEDEC UFS Protocol Information Unit (UPIU) — Big-Endian 32-bit/row Packet Diagram

0x01.name: COMMAND UPIU (0x01)
0x01.description: Host-to-Device SCSI/UFS Command UPIU (32B Header + Optional CDB)

fields.name: Expected Data Transfer Length
fields.description: Expected host-device transfer size in bytes

fields.name: Data Buffer Offset
fields.description: Byte offset in target transfer buffer

fields.name: Data Transfer Count
fields.description: Payload bytes in this DATA OUT UPIU

0x16.name: QUERY REQUEST UPIU (0x16)
0x16.description: UFS Descriptor / Attribute / Flag Query Request UPIU

fields.name: Data Buffer Offset
fields.description: Byte offset into host transfer buffer

fields.name: Data Transfer Count
fields.description: Number of valid data bytes in payload

0x31.name: READY TO TRANSFER (0x31)
0x31.description: Device-to-Host RTT Flow Control for DATA OUT

fields.name: Data Buffer Offset
fields.description: Requested byte offset for DATA OUT

0x36.name: QUERY RESPONSE (0x36)
0x36.description: Device-to-Host Query Response UPIU (Descriptors / Attributes / Flags)

rules.message: REJECT UPIU received from UFS target
